MIDDLE ROW: left = full-body frontal standing view with feet visible, middle = full-body back view, right = full-body left side view. Identical face, hair and clothing in all nine panels, photorealistic, soft even studio lighting. Photorealistic live-action, contemporary Japan (Reiwa era), Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, soft natural key light from upper-left, subtle warm rim light, no flat lighting.
